prompt: In this oil painting, a firefighter in yellow gear stands on the left, holding a shiny brass helmet. Next to him on the left sits a dalmatian with black spots, resting its head on its paws. In the center, a woman in a blue uniform points toward a large red truck parked prominently. The truck has chrome wheels that gleam under the station lights. On the right, an old man in a gray coat looks at the woman while holding a clipboard. Beside him on the right leans a tall metal ladder against the wall. The firefighter hands the helmet to the dalmatian, who lifts its head slightly. The woman gestures for the old man to inspect the truck. There is no smoke in the air.
